_doc: Night vision goggles (docs/NIGHT_OPTICS.md 'Image intensifier', src/render/post/nvg_model.h). Global: ir_moon / ir_sky (near-IR share of moonlight / starlight + airglow), k_vis / k_nir (photocathode weights of the visible / near-IR images), photocathode (GaAs weights on linear RGB: red-heavy), y_sat (screen saturation), overload (G * peak flux / y_sat where the whiteout starts), flip_time (s, the nvg_flip hand case). Variants (items.json 'nvg' names one): phosphor (linear RGB), tubes (1 circle, 2 = figure 8), circle_deg, tube_sep_deg, halo_deg (radius, constant angle), whiteout_recover (s), persistence (s), gain_min / gain_max, target (ABC mean output), settle_down / settle_up (s), damping, tube_px (resolution across a circle, Modern), photons (photoelectrons per tube pixel per frame at flux 1), noise_factor (MCP F), ebi (dark flux), protect_s (bright-source shutoff), runtime_h (hours on one AA), illum_drain, illum_range (m), illum_angle (deg), illum_intensity.
